sources.title: Consular services
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Democratic Republic of the Congo
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry service page is accessible over valid TLS but provides only a generic consular filing procedure, not an exact nationality route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vous devez vous présenter personnellement auprès de l’ambassade ou du consulat compétent.

sources.title: Visa required countries
sources.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of Eswatini
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official table is live over valid TLS, but contains contradictory China and People's Republic of China entries.

sources.title: Visa-free countries
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government page is live over valid TLS and supplies a second country list inconsistent with the required-visa table.

sources.title: Zambia Immigration visa nationality categories
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration, Republic of Zambia
sources.officialityEvidence: The three live Zambia Immigration nationality category pages are accessible over valid TLS; their lists do not expressly map Kosovo and use a legacy Serbia-and-Montenegro label.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of listed countries do not require visas.

sources.title: Entry visa requirements
sources.publisher: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency, Government of Jamaica
sources.officialityEvidence: The live PICA page is accessible over valid TLS but is dated 19 July 2023 and does not directly identify Vatican City or Republic of the Congo passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: PASSPORT, IMMIGRATION & CITIZENSHIP AGENCY – VISA UNIT Last updated July 19, 2023

sources.title: Entry and exit of non-residents
sources.publisher: Public Security Police Force, Macao SAR Government
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Macao government entry page is accessible over valid TLS and separates residence documents, PRC exit permits and conditional passport transit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Holders of a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card or a Re-entry Permit

sources.title: Department of Immigration ETA notice
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Department page is accessible over valid TLS and retains the general ETA system, while the named Kosovo/Syria portal route could not be replayed because eta.gov.lk reset the TLS connection.
sources.supportingExcerpt: nationals of all other countries shall continue to be subject to the general rules and regulations

sources.title: Tourism entry permit for Mainland Area people
sources.publisher: National Immigration Agency, Ministry of the Interior, Republic of China (Taiwan)
sources.officialityEvidence: The live NIA page is accessible over valid TLS and conditions tourism on an entry-exit permit and Mainland travel document rather than an ordinary foreign-passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Applicants must hold an NIA entry and exit permit and a Mainland Area travel document.

sources.title: Visa requirements for foreign passport holders
sources.publisher: Bureau of Consular Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of China (Taiwan)
sources.officialityEvidence: The live BOCA page is accessible over valid TLS but does not affirmatively establish acceptance of Palestinian ordinary passports or travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A foreign passport holder shall enter the ROC with a valid visa.

sources.title: Electronic visa system announcement
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, Republic of Yemen
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry page is accessible over valid TLS and identifies an eVisa platform after competent-authority approval, but gives no Israeli or Kosovo passport outcome.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The electronic visa system is available through yemenevisa.org after competent-authority approval.

sources.title: Travelling to Niue
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government-linked Niue tourism entry page is accessible over valid TLS, supplies a detailed 30-day permit list, and contains an internally inconsistent New Zealand FAQ statement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All other travellers must apply for a visitor visa prior to travel.

unresolved.reason: No current DRC or Zimbabwean authority directly establishes a Zimbabwean ordinary-passport visitor route or issuance timing. Generic consular filing cannot supply a nationality complement.

No current DRC or Republic of the Congo authority directly establishes a Republic-of-the-Congo ordinary-passport visitor route. CEMAC, reciprocity and similarly named Congo material are not transferred.
Kosovo is not directly named in Eswatini's current lists. No current Eswatini or Kosovan authority establishes passport recognition and visitor issuance timing; omission is not a complement.

Eswatini's current official materials conflict: the required-visa table treats China and People's Republic of China differently, while the visa-free list names China. No ordinary-passport baseline is selected.
Zambia's no-visa list uses the legacy combined label Serbia and Montenegro and does not expressly classify a current Serbian ordinary passport.
None of Zambia Immigration's current three nationality-category pages expressly identifies a Kosovo ordinary passport. Omission is not a safe complement.
No current Jamaican or Holy See primary source maps a Vatican City/Holy See ordinary passport to a short-visitor route. The live PICA schedule is dated 2023 and the MFA page is generic.
No current Jamaican or Republic of the Congo primary source maps an ordinary Republic-of-the-Congo passport to Jamaican visitor issuance. PICA does not name this state and no complement is inferred.

Macao's normal exemption requires a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card or Re-entry Permit; an HKSAR passport alone is listed only for seven-day transit with onward-document conditions. This does not establish ordinary tourism.

Macao's normal Mainland entry route uses a Two-way Exit Permit with endorsement, while a PRC passport is listed only for conditional seven-day transit. This cannot be flattened to the CN ordinary-passport code.

Sri Lanka's named Kosovo route is sponsor-led head-office Tourist or Business processing, while a separate Immigration notice retains the general ETA system. The live ETA portal reset its TLS connection and no single passport-only route is established.

Sri Lanka's named Syria route is sponsor-led head-office Tourist or Business processing, while a separate Immigration notice retains the general ETA system. The live ETA portal reset its TLS connection and no single passport-only route is established.

Taiwan's current Mainland tourism route is purpose-, residency-, travel-document-, travel-agency- and permit-conditioned. It does not establish a general foreign ordinary-passport visa or ETA status for CN.
Taiwan's foreign-passport rule does not establish acceptance or recognition of a Palestinian ordinary passport or travel document. Generic visa liability is not transferred to the PS passport code.

Yemen's official eVisa announcement and portal do not supply an Israeli ordinary-passport visitor rule. An omitted entry cannot be converted into visa-required, eVisa, recognition or prohibition treatment.

Yemen's official eVisa announcement and portal do not supply a Kosovo ordinary-passport visitor rule. An omitted entry cannot be converted into visa-required, eVisa, recognition or prohibition treatment.

Niue's live detailed waiver list omits New Zealand, while the same page's FAQ says visa-waiver countries include New Zealand; separate exemption stickers identify Niueans. The internal conflict prevents a nationality-wide ordinary-passport outcome.
Niue's live waiver list names Portugal only for permanent residents. That residence condition does not establish a nationality-wide ordinary Portuguese-passport visitor route.
